mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, the canonical Ehlers Instantaneous Trendline trigger crossing its trendline on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a low-lag trend reversal; follow the trigger relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Trigger crosses strictly above ITrend; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: ITrend is a fixed alpha 0.07 second-order recursive filter of completed median price and Trigger=2*ITrend-ITrend lag2. It is not a simple or exponential price average crossover, return oscillator, prior control, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse recursive low-lag trigger reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.initialization: for first six uninterrupted observations after sufficient lags, (price+2*lag1 price+lag2 price)/4
features.event: current finite nonzero Trigger-ITrend sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers Instantaneous Trendline alpha-0.07 trigger crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no alpha, initialization, recursion, trigger, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers Cybernetic Analysis Instantaneous Trendline convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: median price; alpha=0.07; published second-order ITrend recursion with first-six-bar weighted seed; Trigger=2*ITrend-ITrend[2]; line crossover direction
external_basis.selection_use: published price basis, alpha, initialization, recursion, trigger, and crossover only; no incidence or outcomes
